title: Common definitions
description: Shared definitions referenced by all other schemas. Not a file format on its own.

ms.description: Duration in milliseconds, rounded to 0.1 ms (02-REQ-07).

msOrNull.description: Duration in milliseconds rounded to 0.1 ms, or null when unknown.

msLimit.description: Threshold limit in whole milliseconds, rounded up (02-REQ-08).

ratio.description: Value between 0 and 1 inclusive. The thresholds generator writes at most 3 decimal places (02-REQ-08); hand-written values with more decimals are accepted (02-D-11).

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 with milliseconds, e.g. 2026-11-18T10:00:00.000Z.

epochMs.description: Wall-clock time as whole milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

runId.description: Run identifier, generated by the CLI or by the reporter.

mode.description: Perf mode of the run: 'test' (measurement run) or 'thresholds' (thresholds derivation run).

envLabel.description: Environment label (D-18). Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

envLabelOrNull.description: Environment label, or null when not set.

percentileName.description: Percentile name: 'p' followed by a number greater than 0 and less than 100 with at most one decimal, e.g. p50, p95, p99.9.

key.description: Aggregate key: normalized endpoint key (07) or step key (06). The package limits keys to 2000 UTF-16 code units (07-REQ-18); maxLength here counts code points, so every key the package writes satisfies it.

issue.description: Diagnostic entry: warning, tool error or collector diagnostic (P-12).

message.description: What happened and why, in English.

hint.description: What to do about it, in English.

count.description: How many times the same issue occurred (repeated issues are collapsed into one entry).

evaluationStatus.description: Overall evaluation result: passed (no violations), warned (violations tolerated by gate policy), failed (violations the gate treats as blocking), error (evaluation impossible due to a tool error). Rules: 09.

fingerprint.description: 53-bit hash53 value (08) as 14 lowercase hexadecimal digits, zero-padded.

hostFingerprint.description: Machine that ran the tests. Compared between the thresholds source run and the evaluated run (09-REQ-04).

ci.description: True when the CI environment variable is set.

cpuModel.description: os.cpus()[0].model, trimmed; empty string when unknown.
